name: @unbrained/homeassistant-cli
description: Agent-optimized CLI tool for interacting with the Home Assistant API

scripts.quality:pm: mkdir -p .agents/pm/locks .agents/pm/search && PM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 bun run changelog:pm:install && PM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 bunx @unbrained/pm-cli@latest merge install && PM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 bunx @unbrained/pm-cli@latest gc --scope runtime --json && PM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 bunx @unbrained/pm-cli@latest validate --check-files --check-resolution --check-history-drift --strict-exit --json && PM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 bunx @unbrained/pm-cli@latest health --check-only --strict-exit --json
scripts.quality:static: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run quality:docstrings && bun run quality:duplication && bun run quality:file-size && bun run quality:shell
scripts.security:trivy: trivy fs --scanners vuln,misconfig,secret --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 --ignore-unfixed --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs .git --skip-dirs coverage --skip-dirs dist .
scripts.changelog:pm: bun run changelog:pm:install && bunx @unbrained/pm-cli@latest changelog generate --output CHANGELOG.md --title Changelog --mode replace --all-release-tags --status closed --item-url-base https://github.com/unbraind/homeassistant-cli/blob/master/.agents/pm
scripts.changelog:pm:check: bun run changelog:pm:install && bunx @unbrained/pm-cli@latest changelog generate --output CHANGELOG.md --title Changelog --mode replace --all-release-tags --status closed --item-url-base https://github.com/unbraind/homeassistant-cli/blob/master/.agents/pm --check
